test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

I want all the culprits to be punished immediate.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"be punished immediate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word should be **"immediately"** instead of **"immediate."**
 
• **"Immediate"** is an adjective while** "immediately" **is an adverb.
 
• Adverbs modify verbs, adjectives, and other adverbs while adjectives modify nouns and pronouns.
 
• In this sentence, we need an adverb to modify the verb **"punished"** to indicate when it should happen. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I want all the culprits to be punished **immediately**__.*
